timestamp_semantics: ISO8601 UTC at API boundary; define graph storage adapter consistently

DRAINS_TO.semantics: Verified/candidate directed water-flow connection, not geographical closeness

AFFECTS.semantics: Incident has affected asset, not causal proof

DRAINS_CATCHMENT.semantics: Drains contributing area to known infrastructure; no causation claim

RAINFALL_AFFECTS.semantics: Weather event applies to geographic study area

PICKUP_FOR.semantics: Actual or missed pickup of collection point

DELIVERS.semantics: Durable consumer lease/tracking for domain event

invariants: No cross-category physical causation inferred from closeness
Complaint maps to exactly one current canonical Incident after acceptance
Action task dependency DAG must be acyclic
Approval bound to plan id, version, hash, authenticated APPROVER and expiry
WorkOrder completion does not mean resolution verified
Idempotent source ingestion and work-order creation
Unknown evidence is missing, not fabricated
Plan-approved WorkOrder starts only at AUTHORIZED; WorkOrder draft/pending approval states are prohibited.
No hidden evaluator truth is stored in or reachable from canonical knowledge or document graph.
GraphRAG SDK-managed document graph is separate from canonical domain ontology, linked via stable IDs and verified cited assertions.
